Conservatives understand that mankind’s recent surge in prosperity is fragile, held up by the enlightenment principles of America’s founding. 

Progressives wrongly believe that prosperity is the default setting, able to survive the progressives’ endless tinkering under the moral authority of “social justice” and “equity.”

It always feels nice to shout about compassion. But it’s a farce. True compassion is found in the defense of the foundations upon which prosperity survives.

These therapies save veteran lives. 
 
Huge news and the first milestone crossed after President Trump’s announcement last month that he’s accelerating psychedelic therapies for veterans with PTSD.
 
My legislation to kickstart psychedelic clinical trials passed Congress a few years ago. I’m proud to see the Administration approaching the issue with scientific curiosity.
 
Now there’s real momentum again – and a real hope for veterans fighting the invisible wounds of combat.

“It’s simple.”
